tools.name: chargerdojo_describe_access
tools.description: Explain what this server can do, which tools are open to anyone, and which need a ChargerDojo API key.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_ocpi_versions
tools.description: List the OCPI versions ChargerDojo covers, with what each one is for and which modules are implemented.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_ocpi_version
tools.description: Describe one OCPI version: how the credentials token is encoded, whether endpoints split into sender and receiver, which modules are implemented, and what the known limits are.

tools.name: chargerdojo_compare_ocpi_versions
tools.description: Compare two OCPI versions: what changed in the protocol between them, and which modules ChargerDojo gained.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_journey_templates
tools.description: List the OCPI charging journeys that can be run against the built-in sandbox, with how long each takes.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_conformance_suites
tools.description: List the OCPI conformance suites that can be run, grouped by module, with how many checks each carries.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "chargerdojo_get_ocpi_version" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
